jobs.description:
This is a unique opportunity for you to join as an Airbus First Officer on an enhanced salary package with an accelerated command upgrade scenario.
 
 

• You will need to operate the right-hand seat for a minimum of 700 stick hours and successfully complete two Evidence Based Training (EBT) recurrent training modules. 

• Assuming you meet the standards and display the required level of performance, you will then be eligible for accelerated command via an assessment process and an upgrade course. 

To join our Accelerated Command program, you will need the following experience:
 
 

• Minimum of 5,000 hours total flying time (excluding P3, rotary and single/multi-engine piston aircraft) 

• Minimum of 2,000 hours command time on Boeing/ Airbus FBW types 

• Minimum 1,000 hours command time on Airbus FBW 

• Airbus FBW type flown within the past 3 years 

• Minimum 150 hours in past 12 months on Airbus FBW/Boeing 

• Valid ICAO ATPL with matching Authority Class 1 Medical 

• ICAO English Level 5 or above  

*Airbus FBW excludes A220

Are you a motivated and technically proficient pilot who delivers excellence?
 

We’re looking for Direct Entry Captains to join our growing team. To become one of our A350 or A380 Captains,
 
 

• you will need a minimum of 7,000 hours total flying time in multi-crew, multi-engine aircraft (only time in the operating seat of a turboprop and/or turbojet aircraft is counted; simulator time is excluded). 

Qualification
 

To become one of our Airbus Captains, you will need: 
 
 

• Minimum 7,000 hrs total flying time (excluding P3, rotary and single/multi-engine piston aircraft)  

• Minimum 150 hrs in past 12 months on Airbus FBW as a Captain  

• A valid ICAO ATPL with a matching Authority Class 1 Medical  

• ICAO English level 5 or above  

For A380:
 
 

• Minimum of 3,000 hours PIC on Airbus FBW wide-body (A330/A340/A350/A380) 

• You must currently be flying on Airbus FBW wide-body as a Captain   

For A350:
 
 

• Minimum of 3,000 hours PIC on any Airbus FBW (
A320/A330/A340/A350/A380) 

• You must currently be flying on Airbus FBW as a Captain   

*Airbus FBW excludes A220

Office & Event Assistant to strengthen our medical communication and education team

• Are you an enthusiastic and dedicated team player with a hands-on mentality?

Ismar Healthcare is an independent medical communication and education agency based in Lier, Belgium. We offer high-quality ‘tailor-made’ solutions for and in partnership with the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device industry.

e-HIMS, a sister company of Ismar Healthcare facilitates together with professional associations the development and dissemination of independent CME programmes applying the patented professional development method ‘Mirrors of Medicine’ (MiMe).

As Office Manager, you will be at the heart of the Brussels office, ensuring that everything runs smoothly. You will combine service excellence and operational responsibility whilst working closely with local and international teams to support the day-to-day running of the office and contribute to wider firm initiatives. 

Your Responsibilities
  
• Manage facilities and office services, ensuring the workplace is well equipped, maintained and ready to support colleagues' daily work.  
• Shape the workplace and employee experience to support team growth by identifying practical opportunities to make the Brussels office more welcoming, efficient and well organised.  
• Lead and develop the reception team, creating a high-quality experience for colleagues, clients and visitors.

Our client is a major player in the logistics sector. They handle road transport, air freight, and sea freight.

The Antwerp branch is responsible for everything related to ocean freight. Around 100 employees work there and give their best every day to provide the highest possible level of service. They are seated in groups of four colleagues at work islands, spread over two floors. The atmosphere on the work floor is calm—sometimes hectic—but very pleasant. There is strong teamwork, and there is certainly room for regular laughter as well.

Every two weeks, a fruit basket is delivered to the departments. In addition, you can work with flexible hours, there are various opportunities for personal development, and subscriptions for the toll tunnel and the water bus are fully reimbursed.

In short: a very attractive employer!

Jobomschrijving

Are you detail-oriented and passionate about data, pricing, and ocean freight? 

As a Rate Management Specialist, you’ll play a key role in ensuring accurate and efficient pricing processes that power our global operations.

You’ll manage customer contracts, tariffs, and costing data across our systems, enabling seamless auto-rating and auto-costing and supporting our journey toward full digitalization.

Working closely with commercial, operational, and system teams, you will help deliver tailored pricing solutions that meet customer requirements while supporting ongoing digitalization and process improvement initiatives. This position is essential in maintaining data integrity and optimizing the performance of our global rating platforms.

	
• Strong attention to detail and analytical mindset	
• Experience in Ocean Freight pricing or operations (minimum 2 years)	
• Strong communication and collaboration skills	
• Proficiency in Microsoft 365	
• Fluent English and Dutch

Are you an experienced Office Manager looking for a varied role in a fast-paced international environment? Our client is seeking an organized and proactive professional to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of their Brussels office while supporting business operations and employee experience.

 

Client Details

Our client is a growing international company active in the FMCG sector, known for developing and distributing innovative consumer products across European markets. With a strong focus on quality, sustainability, and collaboration, they have built a dynamic workplace where employees are encouraged to take initiative and contribute to the company's continued success. Their modern offices in Brussels serve as a key hub for their Benelux operations.

 

Description

As Office Manager, you will act as the central point of contact for all office-related matters and play a crucial role in maintaining an efficient and welcoming work environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing the daily operations and overall organization of the office.
• Coordinating suppliers, facility management partners, and external service providers.
• Ensuring office spaces are functional, well-maintained, and fully equipped.
• Organizing internal meetings, events, and company activities.
• Managing office budgets, invoices, and administrative processes.
• Supporting HR-related administration, including onboarding and employee documentation.
• Coordinating travel arrangements, accommodation bookings, and meeting logistics.
• Providing administrative support to the local leadership team.
• Acting as the first point of contact for visitors and external stakeholders.
• Identifying opportunities to improve administrative processes and office efficiency.

 

• You have previous experience in an Office Manager, Administrative Manager, Executive Assistant, or similar position.
• You can demonstrate a successful track record in a professional office environment.
• You have an excellent command of English combined with either French or Dutch.
• Knowledge of the third language (French or Dutch) is considered a strong asset.
• You are highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• You possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• You are hands-on, solution-oriented, and comfortable working independently.
• You have strong attention to detail and a professional approach.
• You are proficient with Microsoft Office and common administrative tools.

We are looking for a motivated logistics professional who thrives in a dynamic international environment.

Requirements

• Administrative experience or strong administrative skills.	
• Comfortable managing multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.	
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 
Proactive and able to work independently. 

Good computer skills and ability to quickly learn new systems.
	
• Fluent in Dutch and English (spoken and written).	
• Strong communication skills with both customers and colleagues.
Personal Qualities
	
• Customer-focused and service-minded.	
• Flexible and willing to go the extra mile when operational needs require it.	
• No strict "9-to-5" mentality.	
• Professional attitude and willingness to follow company procedures, policies, and dress code.	
• Strong team player with a positive mindset.

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues

• You are capable to think out of the box and maintain in the meantime a pragmatic approach
